# usage: crop.py in.png out.png x y w h [scale]  — вырезка и увеличение PNG без PIL (8 бит, RGB/RGBA, без чересстрочности).
import sys, zlib, struct
def read(p):
    b = open(p, 'rb').read(); i = 8; idat = b''; ihdr = None

        if t == b'IHDR': ihdr = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB', d)
        elif t == b'IDAT': idat += d
    w, h, bd, ct, _, _, il = ihdr

    raw = zlib.decompress(idat); stride = w * bpp; rows = []; prev = bytearray(stride); pos = 0

        for x in range(stride):

            if f == 1: line[x] = (line[x] + a) & 255
            elif f == 2: line[x] = (line[x] + up) & 255
            elif f == 3: line[x] = (line[x] + ((a + up) >> 1)) & 255
            elif f == 4:
                pa = abs(up - c); pb = abs(a - c); pc = abs(a + up - 2 * c)

                line[x] = (line[x] + pr) & 255
        rows.append(line); prev = line
    return w, h, bpp, rows
